positive_snippets: The hotel is situated at a prime location at Nehru Place. Room are very clean and services are exemplary. The staff members were very polite and courteous. I had a pleasant stay for 2 days. Food was also good. Would highly recommend this place.

Spl Mention thanks to Mr. Ashish, Receptionist for giving  best support.

Booked this hotel for 3 days and am very much happy with the service....
About Rooms :
Cons :
Room given was little dusty due to some work done on walls.
No toiletries such as tooth brush, comb, slippere were present in the room.

Pros:
Immediately changed my room after informing about the dust.
Immediately provided all the toiletries after informing.

Conclusion:
I feel that problems will be there in any hotel you visit... The only thing is how they are responding once we bring issue to their notice...and at The Pamposh service is much better compared to many other hotels..

Breakfast:
Decent breakfast provided with

Boiled eggs, Parantha, pavbhaji/poori/Bathure, Noodles/uthappam, masala dosa on order, omlette on order, 2juices, one sweet, bread toast, sandwiches, muffins, cut fruits (papaya, watermelon), banana, apples, coffee, tea... One also some chicken snack.

Lunch/Dinner:
Chicken starters and gravy items start at 400/-.
I liked Chicken Tandoori very much here...
So taste wise I feel its good enough.

Room was neat and clean,but fan sound is there and AC indicator light has to be covered slightly,too much lighting.Room service no water bottles for 2nd day and no toothpaste or brush.Food,breakfast was good but ordered dinner was not up to the mark.
